svg.title: Magnetostatic Sources and FullMag Demagnetization Solver Families
svg.desc: Continuum magnetostatic volume and surface charges (rho_m = -div M, sigma_m = M . n) and FullMag's four discrete demagnetization operator families across FDM CPU/GPU and FEM CPU/GPU: (a) FDM 2N zero-padded Hermitian FFT convolution, (b) FEM Poisson with graded shared airbox (tet4 P2, pure_prism_p2, GPU cuDSS or CG/AMG), (c) body-only FEM-BEM Fredkin-Koehler (CPU H2 and GPU CUDA near-CSR/far-ACA with atomic cuDSS or CG/AMG), and (d) periodic FDM truncated images versus FEM reduced periodic_airbox_k0.
